text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is an American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Created(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
FamilyHistory(x) ::: x is Family History.
DaniShapiro(x) ::: x is Dani Shapiro.
Year(x) ::: x is a year.
InYear(x, y) ::: x is in year y.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
CreatedPodcast(x, y) ::: x created y.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x was born in city y.
AmericanCity(y) ::: y is an American city.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.

Premises:
¬Podcast(novel) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, y) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x (Novel(x) ∧ Wrote(y, x) → ∃z (Person(z) ∧ Wrote(z, x) ∧ Novel(z))) ::: If a book is novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
DaniShapiro(dani) ∧ American(dani) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Wrote(familyHistory, dani) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
InYear(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(dani, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
City(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
BornInCity(dani, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
